channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 on 18 November, raising $81.3 billion, plus a $26 billion private placement at the same price, the largest offering on record; shares trade as ANT from today. The same day, Nvidia's quarterly filing showed up to $118 billion of infrastructure guarantees but new language that its neocloud commitments start only once those companies secure their own financing, and US transmission owners asked FERC to bind data centres to 10 to 20 year grid-upgrade contracts with collateral. Salt Lake City banned new data centres for 180 days a day after Loudoun's pause. Capital is flowing to the model labs; the long-dated risk is being pushed onto whoever builds and leases the megawatts. List prices held for a ninth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 19 November 2026
item.description: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 on 18 November, raising $81.3 billion, plus a $26 billion private placement at the same price, the largest offering on record; shares trade as ANT from today. The same day, Nvidia's quarterly filing showed up to $118 billion of infrastructure guarantees but new language that its neocloud commitments start only once those companies secure their own financing, and US transmission owners asked FERC to bind data centres to 10 to 20 year grid-upgrade contracts with collateral. Salt Lake City banned new data centres for 180 days a day after Loudoun's pause. Capital is flowing to the model labs; the long-dated risk is being pushed onto whoever builds and leases the megawatts. List prices held for a ninth day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: United States: Anthropic raises $81.3 billion at $83; transmission owners seek 10 to 20 year data centre contracts at FERC; Nvidia tightens neocloud guarantee terms; Salt Lake City 180-day ban (Wire, 17 to 18 Nov). South Korea: LG Uplus approves up to 789 billion won more for its 200 MW Paju AI data centre (Wire, 19 Nov, corroborated). Israel: Mega Or signs Nebius for 134 MW more; the Masmiya site awaits a frozen grid application (Wire, 19 Nov, single-source). Jordan: Minister previews a 400 MW Al-Risha data centre and a 200 MW AI campus (Wire, 19 Nov, single-source).
